lines.text: Good afternoon, Mrs Achterberg. What are you coming in with today?
I'm coming in with a swollen left knee after a long walk in the hills on Saturday.
Has your doctor given you anything for it?
Yes, I brought the box. Here.
So this says naproxen 250 milligrams, one tablet twice a day with food.
Lie back for me and let me have a look. There's fluid around the kneecap and it only bends to about ninety degrees.
Keep it raised in the evenings and use a bag of frozen peas wrapped in a tea towel for fifteen minutes at a time.
That concludes today's session. Do book a follow up at the desk on your way out.
Good afternoon. Mr Feeney, is it? Please, have a seat.
That's right. I've had pins and needles in my fingers for a month now.
